create_FBModel: create an FBModel instance with obs_dim and action_dim kwargs to initialize backward, forward, and actor networks
load_FBModel: load a pretrained FBModel from a directory path using the FBModel.load class method
save_FBModel: save an FBModel to a folder as safetensors along with its config as JSON
run_reward_inference: run reward-weighted backward inference on next observations to compute a goal vector z
run_goal_inference: run goal inference on next observations to extract and project a latent goal vector z
